payload.recallText: I approach the dean who wanted to eliminate the students who were not wealthy and enroll wealthier ones at Fordham University. I asked hi if he was not betraying the mission of the school and he called me a punk. Someone standing nearby smashed a pie in his face and ran away. I wrote the story and added my own details. I called the person who smashed the pie in his face pie man. The article went viral and soon other students began dressing like him. Pie man wrote me a letter and told me he would soon strike again at a specific location and so he did
